# Shakti Group (Shakti Industrial Gases)

> Official knowledge base and technical catalog for Shakti Group of Companies, premier Indian manufacturer and bulk distributor of cryogenic liquids, industrial gases, and turnkey cryogenic storage systems since 1998.

Official technical knowledge base of **Shakti Group of Companies** (comprising Shakti Gases Pvt. Ltd., Shakti Industrial Gases, Indore Carbonic, and Shaktishree Air Pvt. Ltd.). We operate a 178 TPD Air Separation Unit (producing Liquid Oxygen, Liquid Nitrogen, and Liquid Argon), 270 TPD Liquid Carbon Dioxide manufacturing capacity across 4 locations in India, 65+ dedicated vacuum-insulated cryogenic road tankers, and 6+ regional refilling and testing stations.

## Primary Navigation

- [Home](https://www.shaktigases.com/): Official homepage with manufacturing capacities, ASU infrastructure, and product categories.
- [Products Catalog](https://www.shaktigases.com/products): Complete product index spanning bulk cryogenic liquids, compressed cylinder gases, specialty calibration mixtures, and dry ice.
- [Industries Served](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries): Industrial gas solutions tailored for steelmaking, chemicals, pharma, glass, food & beverage, and energy.
- [Company & Infrastructure](https://www.shaktigases.com/company): Corporate hub detailing group entities, manufacturing plants, logistics fleet, and PESO/ISO quality certifications.
- [Turnkey Storage & Services](https://www.shaktigases.com/services): Zero-capex rental/opex cryogenic storage tanks (3 KL to 60 KL), telemetry monitoring, and manifold piping skids.
- [About Us & Heritage](https://www.shaktigases.com/about): Company history, leadership profile, and operational milestones since 1998.
- [Contact Us & Sales Desk](https://www.shaktigases.com/contact): Direct RFQ desk, plant addresses, emergency logistics dispatch (+91 9727783440), and inquiry form.

## Bulk Cryogenic Liquids & Industrial Gases

- [Liquid Nitrogen (LIN)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/liquid-nitrogen): Purity ≥ 99.999% (Grade 5.0) for fiber laser cutting assist gas (25-35 bar), chemical reactor inerting, cryogenic freezing, and pipeline purging.
- [Liquid Oxygen (LOX)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/liquid-oxygen): Purity ≥ 99.5% for steelmaking decarburization, oxy-fuel glass melting, wastewater ozone enrichment, and medical life support.
- [Liquid Argon (LAR)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/liquid-argon): Purity ≥ 99.999% (Grade 5.0) for TIG/MIG arc welding shielding, stainless steel manufacturing, and ladle metallurgy furnace degassing.
- [Liquid Carbon Dioxide (LCO₂)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/liquid-carbon-dioxide): Food-grade E290 purity ≥ 99.9% for beverage carbonation, ETP effluent pH neutralization, MAP packaging, and dry ice manufacturing.
- [Hydrogen Gas](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/hydrogen-gas): Industrial and UHP compressed hydrogen (200 bar quads & tube cascades) for bright steel annealing, chemical hydrogenation, and fuel cells.
- [Dissolved Acetylene (DA)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/dissolved-acetylene): Purity ≥ 98.0% in porous mass cylinders for high-temperature oxy-acetylene cutting, brazing, and metal fabrication.
- [Helium Gas (He)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/helium-gas): Pure and industrial grade helium for ultra-sensitive mass spectrometer leak detection, optical fiber drawing, and carrier gas.
- [Compressed O₂, N₂, Ar Cylinders](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/industrial-cylinder): High-pressure gaseous cylinders (47L/50L @ 150-200 bar) and 16/32-cylinder MCP manifold quads.

## Specialty & Calibration Gases

- [Calibration Gas Mixtures](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/calibration-gas-mixtures): NIST and NABL traceable multi-component gas mixtures for CEMS stack emissions and chromatography.
- [High Purity Oxygen (99.9999%)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/high-purity-oxygen): Ultra-high purity oxygen for laboratory analytical research and advanced electronics manufacturing.
- [High Purity Chlorine (99.999%)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/high-purity-chlorine): Electronic and chemical grade chlorine in PESO-approved 900kg tonners and cylinders.
- [Carbon Monoxide (CO)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/carbon-monoxide): Specialty-grade gas used in metal carbonyl production and industrial chemical synthesis.
- [Nitrous Oxide (N₂O)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/nitrous-oxide): High-purity medical IP and industrial grade nitrous oxide for healthcare and semiconductor processing.
- [Sulphur Hexafluoride (SF₆)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/sulphur-hexafluoride): Dielectric insulating gas (IEC 60376) for high-voltage GIS electrical substations, breakers, and switchgear.
- [Hydrogen Chloride (HCl)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/hydrogen-chloride): Anhydrous electronic grade HCl for semiconductor plasma etching and pharmaceutical synthesis.
- [Ethylene Gas](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/ethylene-gas): Purity 99.95% for agricultural fruit ripening chambers under FSSAI statutory compliance.
- [Methane Gas](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/methane-gas): Grade 5.0 UHP methane for MPCVD lab-grown diamond reactor synthesis and calibration standards.
- [Propane Gas](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/propane-gas): High-purity fuel gas for precision industrial heating, combustion, and flame processing.
- [Sulphur Dioxide (SO₂)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/sulphur-dioxide): Liquid SO₂ in tonners and cylinders for food preservation and chemical processing.
- [Hydrogen Sulfide (H₂S)](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/hydrogen-sulfide): Specialty grade gas for analytical testing, petrochemical research, and calibration.
- [Solid CO₂ Dry Ice & Dewars](https://www.shaktigases.com/products/other): Food-grade dry ice pellets, high-density blocks (-78.5°C), and liquid nitrogen dewars.

## Industry Solutions

- [Metals, Steel & Heavy Manufacturing](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/metals-manufacturing): Bulk LOX for BOF/EAF steel mills, high-pressure LIN for laser cutting assist, and Argon for shielding.
- [Glass & Ceramics Manufacturing](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/glass-ceramics): Bulk LOX for oxy-fuel glass melting (cuts fuel 30%, slashes NOx 80%) and float glass tin bath atmospheres.
- [Chemicals & Process Plants](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/chemicals-process): Nitrogen blanketing, 200 bar mobile hydrogen cascades, and cryogenic reactor cooling (-196°C).
- [Life Sciences, Healthcare & Pharma](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/life-sciences): Medical oxygen IP with turnkey hospital cryogenic storage tanks and UHP nitrogen for API synthesis.
- [Food & Beverage Processing](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/food-beverage): FSSAI E290 Liquid CO₂ carbonation, LIN flash freezing, MAP packaging blends, and dry ice pellets.
- [Energy, Refineries & Power Infrastructure](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/energy-infrastructure): High-flow refinery nitrogen purging (5,000 Nm³/h), SF₆ for GIS switchgear, and turbine H₂ cooling.
- [Water Treatment & Environmental Engineering](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/water-environment): LOX for ozone generator feed gas (COD/BOD reduction) and Liquid CO₂ for effluent pH neutralization.
- [Electronics & Semiconductor Fabrication](https://www.shaktigases.com/industries/electronics-semiconductor): Grade 6.0 UHP gases for wafer fabs and CH₄/H₂ for MPCVD diamond synthesis.

## Supply Modes & Engineering Services

- [Bulk Gas Supply](https://www.shaktigases.com/solutions/bulk-gas-supply): On-site cryogenic storage installations and automated road tanker telemetry dispatch.
- [Cylinder Gas Supply](https://www.shaktigases.com/solutions/cylinder-gas-supply): Scheduled cylinder bank distribution, manifold racks, and MCP quads.
- [Cryogenic Engineering](https://www.shaktigases.com/solutions/cryogenic-engineering): Turnkey vacuum-insulated storage tanks (3 KL to 60 KL), ambient vaporizers, and VIP piping.
- [Cylinder Services](https://www.shaktigases.com/solutions/cylinder-services): Hydrostatic testing, PESO statutory re-certification, valving, and cylinder maintenance.
- [Export Services](https://www.shaktigases.com/solutions/export): International gas supply, ISO tank containers, and multimodal freight logistics.
